extraction.Name: Mary Standing Soldier, nee Whalen
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent, but that she accepted it on the advice of her father and the employees in the Agency Office
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have the patent recorded herself but she thinks that her father had it recorded
extraction.Buyer: Mr. J.C. Good, of Chadron, Nebraska, but that she does not remember how much she received for it
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by the efforts of her husband
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; in very poor health, suffering with rheumatism; all of her teeth are gone; in a generally run down condition; has no land and no personal property whatever; has two minor children depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since receiving her patent in fee. Subscribed and sworn before notary November 6, 1928.
